print.name: Ikea Lustigt expansion
print.summary: The distance between the shelves was extended to 8 cm
print.description:
Ikea Lustigt expansion. The original wooden central part is too short, and the distance between shelves is not enough to fit figures like Tonies.

I was extending the distance to 8 cm between shelves.

The STL was cut with a dovetail for printer beds up to 22 cm.
